promoters.faq3Q: What type of leads will I receive?

promoters.faq4A: No. All our plans are monthly and you can cancel anytime without penalty. If you cancel, your account remains active until the end of the paid period.
promoters.faq5Q: Can I integrate Tekoha with my CRM?

promoters.faq6A: Projects from Professional and Premium plans appear first in search results and in the featured section of the homepage. This significantly increases visibility and generated leads.
promoters.faq7Q: What payment methods do you accept?
promoters.faq7A: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers and Tigo Money payments. Billing is monthly in USD.

cheRoga.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Che Róga Porã
cheRoga.faq1Q: What is the Che Róga Porã program?
cheRoga.faq1A: It's a public policy of the Paraguayan government managed by the Ministry of Urbanism, Housing and Habitat (MUVH) and financed by the Development Finance Agency (AFD). It provides access to mortgage credits with a fixed rate of 6.5% per year and terms of up to 30 years.
cheRoga.faq2Q: How much is the payment in Che Róga Porã?
cheRoga.faq2A: It depends on the amount and term. For example, a credit of Gs. 350 million over 25 years has a payment of approximately Gs. 2,360,000 per month. You can use our simulator to calculate your specific case.
cheRoga.faq3Q: What homes can you buy with Che Róga Porã?
cheRoga.faq3A: Houses, apartments and land with construction in authorized projects. Amounts range from Gs. 100 million to Gs. 725 million under version 2.0 of the program.
cheRoga.faq4Q: What are the requirements for Che Róga Porã?
cheRoga.faq4A: Be between 18 and 75 years old, family income between 1 and 6 minimum wages, not own a built property, demonstrable job stability and valid personal documentation.
cheRoga.faq5Q: How to apply for the Che Róga Porã credit?
cheRoga.faq5A: First verify your eligibility, then choose a compatible project, and visit a financial intermediary entity (IFI) authorized by the AFD with your documentation.
cheRoga.faq6A: One of the most important benefits is the grace period: you start paying the first installment only when you move into your new home, avoiding overlap with your current rent.
cheRoga.faq7Q: Can I use the program if I already have land?
cheRoga.faq7A: Yes, the program includes the 'Build on your own land' modality, which finances construction on a lot you already own.
